Phase 58 impl @ 97309f7 (branch phase/cockpit-session-lifecycle), per docs/phases/cockpit-session-lifecycle.md.

What changed / where:
- tagteam/watcher.py: acquire_watcher_lock (non-blocking flock / msvcrt LK_NBLCK, holder JSON for messages), other_live_watcher (pidfile + process scan, excluding self and ancestors), refusal before _build_processor (watch → _watch_locked), lock released in finally; SIGTERM→KeyboardInterrupt installed in watch_command.
- tagteam/launch.py: WatcherOwner (one lock around closing check → Popen → record; close() sets closing + snapshots under the same lock; test hook TAGTEAM_TEST_WATCHER_SPAWN_PAUSE_S sleeps after Popen, before record); stop_owned_watchers (handle-based terminate + wait(10), exited / timeout 'kill N' / left-running lines, stale pidfile removal); start_watcher(owner=, source=) and refusal detection ('a watcher is already running (pid N)'); launch(watcher_owner=) → _attempt passes it only when present.
- tagteam/server.py: TagteamHTTPServer.watcher_owner; /api/watch/start and /api/start/launch pass it; serve_command finally prints stop_owned_watchers lines before releasing the port lease.
- tagteam/cockpit_api.py: usage activity items use v10 target_phase/type/round when present (column-tolerant).
- cockpit.js/html/css: ROUNDS {cycle, byN} with setVerdictCycle/applyRounds (loadFeed captures the requested cycle), verdictFor requires the current cycle, RLANE scope via applyLaneScope/renderReviewerLaneScope, 'Show last session' toggle (#btn-reviewer-last), cycle label + dim for other-cycle rows, empty state names the cycle.
- Docs: workflows paragraph (both copies); roadmap backlog item for the lead lane's cycle cards.

DEVIATION (flagged): the lock file is ~/.tagteam/watchers/<sha256(resolved project)[:20]>.lock (TAGTEAM_WATCHER_LOCK_DIR override; autouse conftest isolation), not .tagteam/watcher.lock — tests/test_watcher.py::test_flag_off_watch_creates_no_new_files (3.0-arc constraint) forbids a bare watch writing a new file in the project. Recorded in the phase doc §1.

Verification:
- New tests/test_watcher_lock.py (16): real processes for refusal (pidfile, lock-only holder, process-scan-only 'older release' shim), other project unaffected, CLI exit 1, kill -9 frees the lock, SIGTERM exit 0 + pidfile gone + lock free, SIGTERM kills an in-flight headless turn (agent + grandchild dead, inflight marker cleared), WatcherOwner units, readiness-timeout ownership, external/already-running/reused untouched, start_watcher refusal wording, activity target identity (+ old schema).
- SC5 process-exit tests: a real tagteam serve with the spawn paused 6 s after Popen; SIGTERM lands inside the pause (asserted by timing) for /api/watch/start and for /api/start/launch; serve exits 0 only after the pause, prints 'Stopped watcher pid N', N is dead, pidfile gone. Negative control: with the shutdown call removed the same test fails and leaves an orphaned watcher (observed, then cleaned up).
- tests/test_cockpit_activity.py: harness test updated to the cycle-bound API; new per-cycle scope/toggle test and out-of-order A/B verdict test (SC7, 7a). tests/test_launchpad.py fakes accept owner/source and assert both entry points pass an owner.
- Focused runs: test_watcher_lock, test_launchpad, test_server_cockpit, test_cockpit_activity, test_cockpit_api, test_watcher, test_headless pass. Full suite: see gate entry @ 97309f7.
- Not verified: Windows lock path (no Windows run).
